 D.  COMMITTEE REPORT(S)

There were no Committee Reports.

E.  NEW BUSINESS

There were no New Business items.

F.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, announced that Saturday, March 30, 2024
is the Easter Egg Hunt.

Steve Gomez, Public Safety Director, invited the public to the Junior Safety Fair on Friday, March 15,
2024.

Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Manager, thanked staff and residents who participated in block clean
up.

Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, thanked Gloria Thomas, Housing Rehab Supervisor,
for the 16 years she worked for the city.

G.  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)

There were no City Attorney Reports.

H.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Councilmember Roa congratulated Gloria Thomas; requested that new hires to introduce themselves at
council meetings.

Mayor Pro Tem De Paula, announced that he attended Hawaiian Elementary School Literacy Day;
Coffee with a Cop; and read a letter from a resident who was appreciative of the tutoring provided at the
Lee Ware Center.

Mayor Farfan announced that attended community reading event at Hawaiian Elementary School;
attended a roundtable with the State Treasurer; and attended the block clean up.

Councilmember Roa thanked the maintenance staff for their work.

Councilmember Del Rio thanked staff from Recreation, Public Safety, Public Works, and the Sheriff
Department.

Councilmember Vargas give alot of credit to the middle school and high school programs, and that 55
girls signed up for flag football program.

I.  CLOSED SESSION

There were no Closed Session items.

J.  ADJOURNMENT

The City Council adjourned the meeting at 8:12 PM to the next Regular City Council meeting to be held
on Wednesday, March 27, 2024 at 6:00 PM.
